integrity: Analytical proof supplied with a reproducible supplementary finite checker; no independent validation or priority determination.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns the symmetric antilinear component only, not the skew-adjoint component or a complete spectral measure; an earlier equivalent in Ky Fan or complex-symmetric congruence theory remains possible. Finite experiments supplement but do not establish the universal proof.
title: Trace-frame numerical ranges recover the symmetric antilinear singular profile
